title: Fellow Marine refuses to come forward (text messages)

tellings.quote: My family and military career far exceed anything you are asking of me.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, shares text messages between Michael Herrera, a former Marine who says he saw a 300-foot UFO in the Indonesian jungle, and another Marine from around 2023 or 2024. In the texts, the other Marine refuses to go public and writes that his family and military career matter far more than anything Herrera is asking of him. Michels presents it as a sign that other possible witnesses exist but will not speak.
